taxonomy.name: StackGraph Technical Capability Taxonomy
taxonomy.description: Versioned technical capabilities used to classify dependency and symbol usage.

capabilities.name: HTTP Client
capabilities.description: Issue outbound HTTP requests and process responses.

capabilities.name: JWT / Token Processing
capabilities.description: Create, verify, decode, or validate signed tokens.

capabilities.name: Collection and Object Utilities
capabilities.description: Transform, query, merge, or compare collections and objects.

capabilities.name: Rate and Invocation Control
capabilities.description: Debounce, throttle, retry, or otherwise control invocation rate.

capabilities.name: Schema Validation
capabilities.description: Validate and parse structured application data.

capabilities.name: Application Logging
capabilities.description: Produce structured or unstructured application logs.

capabilities.name: Automated Testing
capabilities.description: Define and execute automated software tests.

capabilities.name: Relational Database Access
capabilities.description: Connect to and query relational databases.

capabilities.name: Web Application Framework
capabilities.description: Route, handle, and compose web application requests.

capabilities.name: Date and Time Processing
capabilities.description: Parse, format, calculate, or compare dates and times.

mappings.rationale: Axios is an HTTP client.
node-fetch implements Fetch for outbound HTTP.
Undici provides HTTP client APIs.
Requests is a Python HTTP client.
HTTPX is a Python HTTP client.
jsonwebtoken signs and verifies JWTs.
jose implements JOSE and JWT operations.
PyJWT encodes and decodes JWTs.
The referenced symbol debounces calls.
The referenced symbol throttles calls.
Lodash broadly provides collection and object utilities.
Zod validates typed schemas.
Joi validates JavaScript values.
Pydantic validates Python data models.
Winston is an application logger.
Pino is an application logger.
structlog provides structured logging.
Jest is an automated test framework.
pytest is an automated test framework.
pg is a PostgreSQL client.
SQLAlchemy provides SQL and ORM access.
Express is a web application framework.
FastAPI is a web application framework.
date-fns provides date and time utilities.
Day.js provides date and time utilities.
Pendulum provides Python date and time utilities.
